fields.galleryPhotos: Gallery photos — one URL per line (optional)

hints.editUrl: URL: /products/{id} (fixed — links keep working after edits)
hints.imageUpload: Upload a photo, or paste a direct image link (https://…). The illustration stays as the fallback if the image fails to load. Pick several at once and the extras go to the gallery below.
hints.hoverVideo: Plays on the product card when a shopper hovers over it. Pick an existing clip or paste a URL/path — keep it short and light (a few MB).
hints.homeImage: Shown on the large home-page card (a lifestyle photo works best). Leave blank to reuse the product image.
hints.gallery: Extra angles for the product page gallery, shown after the main image in this order. Leave empty for a single photo.
hints.placeholderArt: Placeholder art until real product photos land.
hints.visible: Hide it to keep working on it without listing it in the shop, or to pull it from sale without deleting it.
hints.sku: The code Sokochan's warehouse uses for this product. Required to ship it — leave blank for services.
hints.brand: The manufacturer, as Google should see it in the product’s structured data. Defaults to Mammotion — only change it for a robot from another maker.
